## Contact Policy

- **Course questions:** Please post questions about course content on the course Slack so that all students can benefit from the answers.
- **Personal matters:** Contact the instructor directly on Slack or by e-mail
- **Problem set questions:** Post on Slack, bring them to section, or come to office hours.
- **Expected response time:** We aim to respond to discussion posts within 24 hours on weekdays.
